title: About Me
text:
Outside of Work
I grew up in Wisconsin—Go Pack Go! I like to read, listen to podcasts, and puzzle (can you puzzle faster than me?). I recently took a beginner crochet class and am hooked! My favorite TV show is Survivor.
My partner Matt and I enjoy playing cribbage, listening to live music, and walking our Giant Schnauzer, Blu—short for Blugold, a nod to where we met at UW–Eau Claire.

title: Olivia Vruwink  CCC-SLP
text:
My name is Olivia Vruwink (pronounced ‘vroo-wink’). I am a speech-language pathologist and PhD candidate in Speech-Language-Hearing Sciences at the University of Minnesota. I am studying various aspects of rehabilitation after traumatic brain injury (TBI) under the supervision of Dr. Natalie Covington. My research interests include purpose in life in TBI survivors and their care partners, with a focus on how it may contribute to overall well-being and rehabilitation outcomes. I am also interested in the scholarship of teaching and learning (SoTL) in the field of communication sciences and disorders. I aim to obtain a tenure-track faculty position with a mix of research and teaching/clinical responsibilities.
Welcome to my personal website. Many thanks to Samantha Csik for her spectacular tutorial.
